supersedes: benchmark_v1_20260915 BM2 only; BM1 evidence remains immutable
duobox: withdrawn by user; not a prerequisite
actor_identity: person 0 conditions person 1; identities are not verified attacker/defender labels
input: actor body trajectory only; no reactor ground truth, test-derived contact goal or caption
skeleton: 22 named body joints; common mapping for all methods
split: archive train/test retained; 20 percent of training source recordings reserved for validation before windowing
scope: adapted common body-only protocol, not reproduction of ReMoS Table 2
methods: ReMoS upstream body denoiser, Ninjutsu adaptation
contact_arm_gate: No inference-time use of held-out reactor/contact targets. This execution uses a weak training-library nearest-actor contact proposal; not verified tactical contact or the full proposed method.

component_ablation.selection: first chronological window per held-out source, all 3 draws
component_ablation.contact_plan: nearest training actor using 10 uniformly sampled body frames; transfer longest 2+-frame near-surface episode
component_ablation.no_plan_behavior: contact-only remains raw; combined becomes temporal-only

pilot.purpose: runtime, numerical stability and validation pipeline; not confirmation

FID: Do not substitute handcrafted-feature FID for official pretrained evaluator FID. Official metric remains pending evaluator verification.
inference: source-group bootstrap and paired seeds; frames are not independent replicates

robot_utility.status: blocked until existing baseline/test and robot conversion gates pass

release: code, configs and aggregate receipts only; no licensed raw/derived motion or model weights uploaded
